_doc: Signals that fire on no language-crucible file, each with the reason (#4108). tests/tools/signal_coverage.py check fails when a signal not listed here drops to zero, or a listed one starts firing. A zero here is a blind spot of the golden master: a regression in that signal cannot show up in the golden diff.

zero_coverage.Agentic Rce: placeholder: detector removed in #1020; key kept for SIGNAL_SCHEMA positions
zero_coverage.Feature Flags: NO DETECTOR: no rule writes feature_flags anywhere, though it feeds the debt family; the crucible has real flag usage (React's ReactFeatureFlags)
zero_coverage.Invisible Unicode Payload Smuggling: no real public file carries a variation-selector/tag-character payload; the crucible's Unicode examples are negative controls (#4135) and do not trigger. Needs a planted case in keyword-rosetta, not real code
zero_coverage.Prompt Injection: placeholder: detector removed in #1020; key kept for SIGNAL_SCHEMA positions
zero_coverage.Sec Extension Mismatch: no inert-extension file (.txt/.md/.json) parsed as an executable language; real public repos do not ship these, so this needs a planted case in keyword-rosetta
zero_coverage.Sec Tainted Injection: placeholder: computation removed in #3101; key kept for SIGNAL_SCHEMA positions
